topbar_tagline: Independent global passport readiness & document guidance
topbar_sources: Official government portals verified · No approval guarantees
hero_desc: A smart, privacy-first way to prepare for your passport application. Spot inconsistencies before submission, understand verified document alternatives, and connect directly to official government portals.
features_subtitle: Passport requirements differ across countries and family situations. PassportReady organizes the checks that matter.
feat1_desc: Tailored to your issuing country, service type, age group, and domestic or consular filing location.
feat2_desc: Identify discrepancies in name spellings, initials, dates of birth, and addresses before paying fees.
feat3_desc: Discover verified document substitutes and official exception routes when a primary record is unavailable.
feat4_desc: Verify whether your passport meets the specific validity window (e.g. 6 months, 3 months, or duration of stay) mandated by your destination.
feat5_desc: Direct links to genuine foreign ministries, consular portals, and official appointment booking systems.
feat6_desc: Save or print your personalized pre-submission action plan with zero trackers or account creation.
wizard_sub: Answer a few simple questions to generate your personalized document checklist and identify potential issues.
tools_photo_title: Biometric Passport Photo & Aspect Ratio Validator
tools_photo_desc: Avoid application rejection. Check your photo dimensions, aspect ratio, and face alignment against ICAO 9303, US 2x2 inch, and Canadian biometric standards.
photo_privacy_guarantee: 100% Client-Side Privacy: Your photo is evaluated locally in your browser. No image data is ever uploaded or transmitted.
toast_offline_ready: Application is ready for 100% offline use!
toast_offline_active: You are offline. Full checklist evaluation and tools remain available locally.
step1_helper: Select the passport-issuing authority and whether you are applying domestically or at an overseas embassy.
country_placeholder: Type country name (e.g., India, United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Philippines)...
opt_consular: Abroad / Overseas (Embassy, High Commission or Consulate)
step2_helper: The application route and required forms vary significantly by service type.
step3_helper: Applicant age determines legal consent, biometric exemptions, validity period, and fees.
step4_helper: Expedited or Tatkaal routes have specific eligibility rules and higher fees.
step5_helper: Previous passports must be accounted for or physically surrendered for cancellation.
label_status: What is the status of your existing passport?
stat_damaged: Physically damaged / pages detached / water damage
step6_helper: Indicate whether you possess the foundational identity and citizenship records.
label_birth_proof: Proof of Birth / Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / School record / National ID)
label_address_proof: Proof of Current Address (Utility bills / Aadhaar / Driving licence / Bank record)
label_citizenship_proof: Proof of Citizenship / Naturalization (Parent documents / Certificate)
doc_have: Yes, I have original official document
doc_partial: I have a photocopy or digital copy only
doc_missing: I do not have this document (need alternatives)
step7_helper: Spelling inconsistencies, inverted given and family names, or date-of-birth format errors commonly trigger processing delays.
label_name_match: Do the applicant's name spellings match exactly across all documents?
match_yes: Yes — First, middle, and last names match character-for-character
match_minor: Minor difference (e.g., initials used, abbreviation, single letter)
match_major: Significant difference (different surname, married name, name changed)
label_dob_match: Does the date of birth match across records?
dob_yes: Yes — Exactly identical across all documents
dob_mismatch: No — Day, month, or year differs on one document
step8_helper: Select any additional circumstance that applies to this application.
spec_address_change: Moved address within the last 12 months
spec_custody: Single parent / Legal guardianship / Custody order
spec_dual_nat: Dual nationality or hold foreign citizenship / residence
spec_pages_full: Passport validity remains, but visa pages are full
step9_helper: Final check before building your personalized readiness action plan.
label_checked_gov: Have you reviewed the issuing authority's official portal?
gov_yes: Yes, I have reviewed the official portal
gov_no: Not yet — I need the direct official link
tools_expiry_desc: Entry requirements depend on destination: some require 6 months validity, European Schengen countries require 3 months beyond departure, while others require validity only for the duration of stay.
tools_mismatch_desc: Compare Document A (e.g., Birth Certificate / Old Passport) with Document B (e.g., National ID / Educational Certificate).
footer_disclaimer: PassportReady is an independent preparation guide and is not affiliated with any government or passport-issuing authority. We do not issue passports, schedule official appointments, or collect passport numbers. Always verify final requirements and fees on official government portals.
translation_disclaimer: Informative translation — does not replace legally binding official instructions from passport authorities.
score_disclaimer: Readiness score reflects document preparation completeness only; it does not calculate, indicate, or guarantee passport issuance or approval.
cov_evidence_incomplete: ℹ Valid Source Reference · Incomplete Claim Evidence
flags_none_desc: Your personal particulars appear consistent across records. Review the required document checklist below.
flag_unverified_msg: Detailed scenario rules for {country} are undergoing official research. This checklist reflects baseline international preparation standards (ICAO Doc 9303).
flag_unverified_action: Confirm specific accepted document alternatives, forms, and fees directly with the official authority of {country} before applying.
flag_name_major_msg: Your name differs substantially across records. Submitting without statutory name change proof will result in processing suspension or rejection.
flag_name_minor_msg: A difference in spelling, initials, or name order was reported. Authorities require proof that both names belong to the same person.
flag_name_minor_action: Ensure your application form separates Given Name and Family Name exactly as assigned on your primary citizenship certificate.
flag_dob_mismatch_msg: Date of birth differences are strictly audited by passport authorities. The date recorded on your primary civil birth certificate or first citizenship grant legally supersedes dates on secondary cards.
flag_dob_mismatch_action: If an educational certificate or national ID has an incorrect birth date, reconcile the discrepancy with the issuing civil authority before submitting your passport application.
flag_birth_missing_msg: You indicated that primary civil birth documentation is missing.
flag_address_missing_msg: Passports require verifiable proof of your physical residence for territorial jurisdiction, background checks, and delivery.
flag_address_missing_action: Secure a registered residential agreement, continuous utility bills, or active bank passbook.
flag_lost_report_title: Official Loss Declaration / Police Report Required
flag_lost_report_msg: Lost travel documents must be officially declared to prevent identity theft and fraud.
flag_minor_consent_title: Parental Consent & Custody Safeguards for Minors
flag_minor_consent_msg: Passports for children under statutory majority age cannot be processed without legally documented consent from parents or legal guardians.
flag_consular_msg: You have selected an overseas / consular application. Processing timelines, booking systems, and fee structures differ significantly from domestic passport offices.
flag_consular_action: Check your nearest {country} embassy or consulate website to confirm whether applications are handled directly by the consular section or through an authorized service partner.
flag_emergency_doc_msg: Emergency travel certificates or temporary passports usually have short validity (typically 30 days to 1 year) and are frequently valid ONLY for direct return travel to your country of citizenship.
flag_emergency_doc_action: Confirm destination acceptance before purchasing non-refundable transit or flight tickets.
chk_name_correction_title: Secure Statutory Proof of Legal Name Change
chk_name_correction_details_verified: Obtain official evidence conforming to {country} legal requirements.
chk_name_correction_details_unverified: Obtain certified court order, marriage certificate, or official government gazette / deed poll matching your jurisdiction.
chk_name_split_title: Reconcile Given Name vs. Family Name Allocation
chk_name_split_details: Ensure your application form separates Given Name and Surname exactly as they appear in your primary civil registration.
chk_dob_discrepancy_title: Verify Primary Civil Birth Record for DOB Precedence
chk_dob_discrepancy_details: Ensure the application form reflects the exact birth date established in your primary civil registration.
chk_citizenship_details_verified: Provide original civil birth certificate or naturalization record demonstrating {country} citizenship.
chk_identity_details: Valid unexpired government-issued photo card (National ID, Driver’s Licence, State ID).
chk_address_details: Documentation proving your residence at your present physical address.
chk_old_passport_title: Submit Existing Passport for Physical Cancellation
chk_old_passport_details: Original existing passport booklet must be presented. It will be physically cancelled and returned with the new passport.
chk_expired_validity_details: If expired by more than 3 years, authorities in jurisdictions such as India and the US require fresh identity verification.
chk_loss_statement_title: Formal Statement Explaining Circumstances of Loss
chk_loss_statement_details: Formal written statement detailing the precise circumstances under which the passport was lost.
chk_damaged_surrender_details: Present the damaged passport. If biographical data or electronic chip is compromised, it may be processed under mutilated travel document rules.
chk_parental_consent_details: Full birth certificate naming parents, plus valid photo IDs of parents and formal statutory consent.
chk_consular_jurisdiction_details: Verify which embassy, high commission, or authorized application center serves your current residential area. Do not assume a private intermediary is required without verifying your mission's direct guidance.
chk_residence_visa_title: Proof of Legal Residence in Host Country
chk_residence_visa_details: Current valid residency visa, work permit, permanent resident card, or residence certificate showing lawful status in the host nation.
chk_consular_fee_title: Verify Consular Fee Surcharge & Payment Currency
chk_consular_fee_details: Passports issued overseas frequently carry statutory consular surcharges and require payment in local host currency, debit card, or postal money order.
chk_domestic_appointment_title: Book Appointment at Authorized Domestic Center
chk_domestic_appointment_portal: Schedule appointment through the verified portal: {portal}
chk_domestic_appointment_general: Schedule appointment through the official passport authority of {country}.
chk_expedited_slot_details: Confirm whether your specific service qualifies for expedited processing. Certain cases (major name changes, lost passports without prior record) may be excluded from expedited streams.
chk_photo_spec_title: ICAO-Compliant Passport Photos or Live Capture
chk_id_marriage_title: Submit Authenticated Marriage Certificate (Buku Nikah / Akta Perkawinan)
chk_id_marriage_details: Under Permenkumham No. 18/2022 Pasal 2A, citizens under 17 qualify for 10-year validity upon presenting original government marriage certificate.
photo_fallback_guidelines: Ensure photos for {country} follow standard ICAO 9303 guidelines: neutral expression, no glasses, mouth closed, compliant background colour.
photo_live_capture: Live Capture: Photos are captured live digitally at the official appointment center or enrollment counter
fee_guidance_default: Always pay fees directly through the government portal, designated post office, or authorized bank challan. Never pay private agents claiming to guarantee approval.
fee_guidance_consular_general: Overseas consular passport fees for {country} are collected in host country local currency or USD by diplomatic missions. Domestic statutory tariffs do not apply abroad. Check the accredited embassy portal for current fee schedules.
fee_guidance_domestic_general: Official statutory fee schedule for {country}: Please verify the exact applicable fee and payment channel directly on the official portal ({portal}).
fee_guidance_confirm_verified: Fee Confirmation Required: Statutory fee schedule for "{service}" in {country} is not yet individually verified in this rule pack. Check the official portal of {authority} before making payment.
fee_guidance_confirm_unverified: Fee Confirmation Required: Official statutory fees for {country} have not been individually verified. Confirm the current statutory fee and official payment channel directly on the official government portal before making any payment.
source_card_verified_desc: Direct government portal verified for {country}. Always complete final filing and fee payments directly on official government servers.
source_card_unverified_desc: PassportReady has not yet completed a primary source audit for this jurisdiction. Use this checklist as preparatory guidance, and contact your national foreign ministry or embassy for definitive local rules.
presubmission_notice: Pre-Submission Rule: This checklist reflects standard requirements. Government authorities reserve the legal right to request additional supporting documents, police reports, or biometric re-examinations.
flag_minor_consent_action: Ensure all required parents attend the appointment or provide statutory notarized consent.
country_prompt_desc: Please type or select your passport-issuing authority from the list.
country_unresolved_desc: Please select a recognized country from the suggested list.
country_verified_desc: Official requirements and document standards fully researched and updated for 2026.
country_linked_desc: Official portal link recorded; scenario-specific rules undergoing detailed research.
country_awaiting_desc: Official passport authority link currently undergoing research. Generic preparation guidance provided.
country_continue_error: Please type and select a recognized passport-issuing authority before continuing.
beta_notice_text: PassportReady is an independent preparation guide and not an official government service. Currently providing tested guidance for 27 verified jurisdictions; other countries display baseline international standards awaiting full research.
unsupported_coverage_action: This service scenario is in public beta and not yet fully audited with claim-level evidence. Confirm all forms, fees, and requirements directly with official authorities.
